_comment: Read by micro/publish.sh at deploy. includePrototypeBrowser: true publishes the prototype browser (the list at /micro/prototypes/ and the split-screen demo); includeWorkbenches: true publishes the workbench at /micro/workbench/ (the Audio tab). false leaves either out, while the game at /micro/ and the world pages it hosts still deploy. A missing or unreadable file, or a missing key, counts as true.
